mapper.sql: FROM appointment a JOIN interrupted_appointment i ON i.appointment_id = a.id JOIN schedule_interruption sc ON sc.schedule_id = i.schedule_id JOIN ( SELECT 'STOPPED' AS kind UNION ALL SELECT 'ARRANGEMENT' ) event ON event.kind = 'STOPPED' OR i.arranged_at IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN appointment_notice_receipt r ON r.appointment_id = a.id AND r.notice_kind = event.kind
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) - COUNT(r.read_at) AS unread
WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId}

SELECT a.appointment_no, event.kind, CASE WHEN event.kind = 'STOPPED' THEN sc.occurred_at ELSE i.arranged_at END AS occurred_at, sched.schedule_date, d.name AS department_name, dr.name AS doctor_name, r.read_at IS NULL AS unread
JOIN doctor_schedule sched ON sched.id = i.schedule_id JOIN department d ON d.id = a.department_id JOIN doctor dr ON dr.id = a.doctor_id WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY unread DESC, occurred_at DESC, a.id DESC, event.kind LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
